items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Stanley Dance, he called up and he said, 'Helen can I come out?' I said, 'alright'. I went over and picked him up.

ctx.x: Well listen Helen, I think the time has come and get started now and think about what happened after you had gone home, which we talked about earlier, and you were taking care of your dad and it was about 1973, and Stanley Dance.
Stanley Dance, he called up and he said, 'Helen can I come out?' I said, 'alright'. I went over and picked him up.
